The Iron Golem is an explicit golem instance with dedicated creation and family lore, directly answering broad golem discovery.
Bloodshroud has associated innate Disintegrate, but the returned creature is incidental caster context for the named spell.
Bloodshroud contains Disintegrate among innate spell records, providing related ownership context rather than the spell as returned subject.

This spherical artifact is linked to Horsemen of the Apocalypse and can engineer mass tragedy, a substantive apocalyptic-orb relationship. Its actual powers are scrying, binding and suggestion, not Armageddon Orb identity.

adjudication.rationale: Useful qualified apocalyptic-orb alternative: the Oculus is explicitly a spherical artifact associated with the Horsemen of the Apocalypse and can manipulate an entire mile's population toward a horrific fate. This is a concrete thematic relationship beyond merely sharing an orb shape. Its actual powers concern scrying, binding, observation and mass suggestion; the source does not establish Armageddon Orb identity or equivalence.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If the query is for the particular Armageddon Orb identity or its specific effect, this different artifact is only substantively related apocalyptic lore/item content.

Its serpent tail projects flame, and its other inspected attacks use chains/claws/horns; this is a related tail-weapon monster, but not a tail-spike shooter.

Spirit Priest contains Spiritual Armament, providing related caster context for the partial name. The root is an individual creature rather than the requested spell subject.
Type II is a close spacious-pouch variant with the same extradimensional-storage purpose, qualified by its different type and 50-Bulk capacity.
A human seer genuinely watches stars for divination, but is not a dog. The publication title alone is not the basis for the relationship.
Sakuachi explicitly reads the stars, but is a human dream seer rather than a dog. She meets the stargazing part only.
A sun/moon-associated canine is substantively celestial-dog content, but no source establishes star-watching behavior or astronomy.
This is a celestial canine tied to the sun and moon, substantively related to celestial dogs. Its source describes heat/cold powers and stealing those bodies rather than star-watching.
A rule releasing a vermin swarm from a zombie does not concern Enfeebled; the shared rule kind is insufficient.
This rule releases vermin when a zombie is critically hit or destroyed, with no Enfeebled content.

This exact level-20 Blue Viper is poison-themed and attacks with poisons, but neither his immunity nor his complete special-action set supplies removal of poison from food. No meal-poisoning reversal is claimed from attacks on creatures.
This identifies a kholo, the object of the requested worship relationship, but not a gremlin worshipper or evidence of that relationship.
The sergeant is a kholo and explains kholo society, a substantive relation to the requested worshipped group, but is not a gremlin and establishes no gremlin worship relationship.
An actual Silver Sustenance ability lets this fey subsist on silver and heal; useful qualified sustenance content within a creature, limited to the ailuran itself.
The ailuran has explicit intrinsic Silver Sustenance: it can subsist on silver instead of normal food and heal by eating silver. This directly answers the broad sustenance subject.
Exact mirror equipment directly answers the unrestricted mirror query.
A dedicated Harrowkin family ability directly answers unrestricted Harrowkin subject discovery.
This is a dedicated harrowkin family ability governing initiative reshuffling, directly useful for the broad harrowkin subject.

Dedicated ammunition for a backpack ballista is a useful related accessory answer. It is a bolt rather than a ballista weapon, and this sparse source establishes no additional mechanics.
A dragon-command artifact orb with elemental-blast powers is related magical-orb content, but no source establishes the named Armageddon Orb or a specifically apocalyptic function.

This orb is dedicated to dragon senses, domination and breath powers. Shared orb shape and artifact status do not establish Armageddon Orb identity or a supported close substitute for that named item.

Razor Snare can actually knock its victim prone on a critical hit. It is useful condition-application content, qualified by that critical-hit requirement and by being a trap rather than the condition record.
Padli wears Leather Armor, an incidental owner context for the named equipment query.
Kelganth has Sending prepared, but the lich root is incidental caster context for the named spell.
Kelganth has Sending actually prepared, establishing a real reference, but the lich root has no dedicated Sending subject beyond its large spell list.

This effect grants a bonus to a non-attack skill check; it neither explains, causes nor removes Enfeebled. A generic bonus is insufficient condition relevance.
Direct encounter answer: deer investigate delicious-looking leshies and repeatedly nibble the PCs, matching the hazard-filtered request.
The grazing-deer hazard explicitly investigates delicious-looking leshys and eagerly nibbles PCs, directly matching the requested deer threat.

Ioseff has associated innate Dream Message, related long-distance messaging, but it is one-way and waits for sleep. The site-bound ghost is incidental alternative-spell context rather than a dedicated Sending answer.

The wound recording device is an actual clockwork item with dedicated operation rules, directly answering the unfiltered clockwork subject.

The potion creates an acid aura that damages touching creatures, directly useful acid content.
The ladder breaks away and causes falls, with no clothing-staining mechanism in the root or reaction.
The ladder breaks away and causes a fall; the source supplies no staining material or clothing-staining effect.
A giant spider is not a giant slug or a close source-supported slug variant; giant animal vocabulary alone is insufficient.
This is a giant spider, not a giant slug or a source-supported slug variant. Shared giant-animal status is insufficient.
Popcorn includes actual Plant Nourishment plus cooking/Seasoned mechanics, useful qualified sustenance content within a broader character.

Popcorn has intrinsic Plant Nourishment, explaining how her leshy body obtains sustenance without ordinary paid food and the sunlight-starvation limitation. This directly supplies broad sustenance content.

The feat explicitly supplies nourishment through photosynthesis instead of food, directly answering sustenance. It requires sunlight within a week or costly bottled sunlight.

This reaction is triggered by polymorph growth and then shoves or trips, a substantive polymorph relationship. It neither creates a polymorph effect nor supplies a Polymorph Trap.

The golem has a special interaction with Disintegrate, taking reduced damage and being slowed. This is target-specific related context rather than the spell itself.

The marsh giant actually knocks targets prone with Twist the Hook and then exploits that condition with Drowning Hook. This is meaningful condition-use content through a creature rather than the Prone rule.

The trap sprays cleaning chemicals and caustic vapor, substantively related to a chemical spray trap. It describes acid injury and vision effects, not stains on clothes or actual stain removal.

The Type III smuggler sack is a dedicated extradimensional storage alternative with a 10-Bulk hidden pocket. It is a different specialized bag, not the exact Type I Spacious Pouch.

Seelah has a taken Intimidating Glare feat that permits visual Demoralize without auditory language. She is a useful identified-user example rather than the method as a standalone feat.

This curse visibly brands crimes until restitution. It supplies no source-supported Assurance completion or related assur subject.

The furnace is related through dangerous heated vent discharges, but spews acid/fire/poison boiling toxins rather than steam. It does not supply steam vents or an equivalent steam hazard.

This supplies a usable vent-trap structure. Its discharge is toxin with acid/fire/poison damage rather than ordinary steam, and it is not established as the Steam Vents identity.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If Steam Vents means the exact hazard or specifically water-vapor vents, the furnace is only related heated/toxic-vent content and does not establish that requested substance or identity.

adjudication.rationale: Useful qualified prone-prevention content: while in this stance and on the ground, an effect that would knock the recipient prone instead fails to do so and permits a free Step. This is a dedicated defensive condition interaction, not incidental vocabulary. It represents an applied stance effect rather than the base Prone definition. Because the query requests a subject rather than an infliction outcome, prevention is not an opposite-function flag.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If the query seeks the base Prone condition rule only, this stance-specific defensive interaction is related content rather than the condition definition.

The ritual centers on an elaborate feast and spreading revelry, but does not establish food that fails to satisfy or nourish. It meets only the banquet component.

This feat directly grants a climb Speed, with further surface-specific improvement if Scuttle Up is present, directly useful climbing content.

Kangir carries a crowbar in her backpack. This is incidental tool ownership rather than a dedicated Crowbar answer.

A close basilisk-related crossbreed retaining petrifying gaze, rather than the basilisk itself.

Kellsti contains Battle Medicine; the returned character provides ownership context rather than the requested feat record.

Ooze Skin is armor made with ooze extract and activated by acid, a substantive ooze-acid relation. It identifies no ooze satisfying the requested metal-sparing acid property.

This dedicated action is useful Prone-related rules content: it tells how to voluntarily become prone for one action. It does not explain the condition itself.

Quizrel has Trap Finder, making this a useful character example of detecting traps without Searching.
Quizrel actually has Trap Finder, which grants trap checks even without Searching while retaining other discovery requirements. The character is a useful indirect example of the requested capability.

The queen has Astronomy Lore and seasonal nature stewardship, a substantive stars relationship, but is a nymph with humanoid shapeshifting rather than a star-watching dog.
A mental illusion trap that suppresses a skill feat is not a polymorph trap or a meaningfully similar transformation hazard. Shared magical-trap category is insufficient.
This trap inflicts memories of failure and can remove access to a skill feat. It does not polymorph bodies or supply a transformation-trap alternative.

A useful related lava hazard: a lava river spews molten debris that cools on victims. It is mold-triggered spatter rather than a dedicated lava flume, with its own disabling mechanics.

An actual flesh golem with dedicated golem lore directly answers the broad golem subject.

The devil has associated at-will Locate that explicitly finds the direction to a known specific sword. It is a useful indirect provider, subject to 500-foot range and lead/running-water blocks.
This friendship-themed Harrow artifact improves Aid and attitudes; it has no crowbar or prying function.
The Publican is a Harrow artifact for Aid and social attitudes, with tavern lore. Its pub association does not establish a crowbar or an entry-tool substitute.

Horn Snare catches an attacking weapon to Disarm it; this is a related snaring maneuver, not a useful snare trap. Root soul-restraint lore does not supply one.

The treasure pile collapses in a wave of solid objects, without molten lava or a flume. The action name Flood does not establish the requested material or mechanism.

The taskmaster contains Shield among its spells, providing incidental caster context rather than dedicated shield content.

The priest contains Spiritual Weapon, a related ghostly weapon spell. The returned priest is incidental caster context rather than the spiritual arma spell subject.

The cannon is made from a basilisk body and reproduces petrification through a Basilisk Beam, making it useful basilisk-derived equipment content. It is a weapon rather than a living basilisk.

adjudication.rationale: Related deceptive-meal haunt: it disguises jagged bones and husks as appetizing food, compels consumption and causes slashing damage. Its remaining routine batters creatures with dust/bones, and its reset can end when someone eats a full meal at the desk. The source does not establish a banquet that continues without satisfying hunger, so that defining function remains unmet; the removal condition alone is not proof of an opposite-function result.

alternativeGrades.rationale: For a loose thematic request for a cursed, alluring meal that fails to nourish, its illusory refuse and compelled harmful eating can be useful inspiration. That interpretation broadens the literal never-satisfying-banquet function; no endless food or continuing hunger mechanic is established.

This dedicated climbing kit improves Athletics and helps prevent falls, directly answering climbing equipment.

A frost-themed drake with cold immunity, freezing mist breath and ice-related movement directly answers broad frost content.
Despite the figurative resurrection name, this tea heals living recipients and improves recovery checks; it supplies no return from death.

A useful related thunderous hazard using cascading explosive thunderstones, with sonic damage and deafness rather than the named Thunderclap hazard.
The hazard makes thunderstones explode with sonic damage and deafening, directly supplying a thunderclap-type hazard. The trip wire is its ordinary trigger.

The Pillow Shield is an actual steel shield variant with shield stats, a rest-repair function and an Alarm activation, directly answering broad shield discovery.

Lisavet actually prepares Shield, establishing a real spell reference, but the healer creature root is incidental spell-list context rather than dedicated shield rules, equipment or tactics.

The mystic has Sending actually prepared, establishing a substantive reference, but the cleric root remains incidental spell-list context rather than the requested spell or dedicated communication content.

The root explicitly describes a stuffed bear that animates and bites, and Chomp supplies the contact-triggered jaws Strike. This directly matches.

A useful grappling-centered creature example with incorporeal grapples and submission maneuvers, rather than the standalone Grapple action.

The demonologist prepares Acid Arrow and Acid Splash, but remains incidental acid content in an otherwise unrelated caster record rather than a dedicated acid answer.

This is an actual razor-wire snare with tripwire trigger and suspension/bleeding mechanics, directly answering the broad snare query.

A useful resurrection-support feat: it grants fast healing to a creature you return to life or heal while dying. It does not itself bring a dead creature back.
The random outcome table includes Mind Reading on 73–77, but does not provide a dependable thought-reading method or its mechanics.

The assigned random-effects table lists Mind Reading on results 73–77, but provides neither that spell mechanics nor the rod activation/targeting rules. The source establishes a relevant random reference but is insufficient to grade it as a practical thought-reading method.

adjudication.rationale: Resolved as a useful but heavily qualified thought-reading route: the actual rod targets a chosen creature within 60 feet and casts a named table spell at its lowest rank with DC 27. The table's Mind Reading document ID exactly matches the supplied third-rank spell, which really reveals the target's vague surface thoughts on a failed Will save. Its direct entry occupies only 73–77 on d100, the effect cannot be selected, the rod then waits 1d4 hours, and the spell grants one-hour target immunity. The returned root is the random table rather than a dependable standalone spell. The opposite flag is narrowly conditional: on the target's critical-success save, the spell explicitly lets the target read the caster's surface thoughts instead, reversing the requested information flow; it does not describe the ordinary failure branch.

alternativeGrades.rationale: A defensible practical-usefulness threshold can treat this as related-only: the needed effect cannot be chosen, its direct entry is just five percentile results, failed activations still impose an hours-long cooldown, and the chosen target must then fail a Will save to reveal thoughts. This alternative judges a fully established but very unreliable method; it is not a bound invented for missing spell evidence.

opinions.rationale: This general mouther variant has Grab and Engulf, but is incidental restraint content rather than dedicated Grapple guidance or a grappling-centered alternative. The Grab mechanics are a localization token.

Demontangle has a jaws attack linked to Grab and an embedded Grab action, establishing a grappling relationship. The actual Grab mechanics are only an unresolved localization reference here, so this is related creature context rather than a fully supported Grapple method or rule.
The haunt magically shuts and locks a door, reversing the requested opening outcome; mundane disabling/opening instructions do not supply opening magic.
The haunt magically shuts and locks a door after passage, reversing the requested opening of a locked door. Its disable entries describe mundane ways to oppose it rather than an opening spell.
A useful close hostile-stuffed-animal hazard: a stuffed owlbear animates, but its attack is cold breath rather than biting.
An animated stuffed owlbear is substantively close to the requested stuffed-bear threat, but it breathes cold rather than bites.

adjudication.rationale: The source establishes an animated hostile stuffed owlbear, which is substantively close to a stuffed-bear threat. However, the complete trap has a cold-breath burst and frostbite/clumsiness rather than any bite attack. The defining biting function is not supplied by this record.

alternativeGrades.rationale: For looser discovery of a dangerous animated stuffed bear-like display, this owlbear trap is a useful qualified alternative. That interpretation must preserve that its attack is cold breath, not a bite.

opinions.rationale: This mindless acidic ooze has no supported jellyfish form, alien origin or friendliness. A jelly word match does not establish the requested concept.
This stabilized ochre jelly is a mindless acid ooze. The source establishes neither jellyfish identity, alien origin nor friendliness; jelly in its name is not sufficient.
The rotating pendulum pit attacks creatures and blocks exits, with no lockpick-breaking function. Shared trap category is insufficient.
This trap rotates a chamber and attacks with force pendulums, without a lockpick-breaking mechanism. Its Locking Room name describes sealed exits, not damaging thieves tools.
A bull-sized reptilian predator is not a badger or a close badger variant. Burrowing alone does not create that identity.
The hodag is a bull-sized spiny reptilian beast, not a badger or a source-supported badger variant. Burrowing alone is insufficient.
An actual vampire with blood-drinking mechanics directly answers broad vampiric discovery.
The servant is an actual vampire with intrinsic blood-drinking that heals itself, directly useful vampiric content.
A two-handed melee strike with a sonic cone is neither Magic Missile nor a meaningfully similar force-missile alternative. Shared damaging-spell category is insufficient.
A bolt-firing hand crossbow has no crowbar or prying function. Similar spelling is coincidental.
This crossbow fires bolts, with no crowbar or prying function. Similar title letters do not establish relevance.
The protean merely includes Disintegrate among many spells; its broader reality-altering powers do not make it a dedicated Disintegrate result.
Izfiitar contains Disintegrate among many spells, providing related caster context rather than the requested spell as subject.
This ooze explicitly damages metal with its acid, reversing the requested metal-preserving outcome. Sparing stone does not satisfy sparing metal.
The ooze's acid expressly damages metal, the reverse of the required metal-sparing function. It remains related acid-ooze content.
A dedicated Frost Vial rules effect explains its slowing penalty and item variants, useful direct broad frost content.
This dedicated Frost Vial effect explains and implements the speed penalty from frost vials, directly answering broad frost-rule discovery without inventing additional damage.
An actual wand that casts fire magic and leaves rolling flames directly answers wand of fire.
This wand casts Floating Flame and creates damaging rolling fire, directly satisfying the broad fire-wand description.
The spell treats disease or poison afflicting a willing creature, not poison in a meal. The different recipient prevents it from satisfying food purification.
Purging Toxins counteracts poison afflicting a willing creature, not poison in food. It is related poison treatment but cannot cleanse the requested meal.
An actual reflecting buckler directly answers the broad shield category.
This buckler provides shield defenses and a spell-reflecting activation.
A dedicated consumable snare that hooks and restrains creatures directly answers snare.
This pit is related pit content, but its maggots are explicitly impossible to miss; there is no concealed floor/falling trap or useful Hidden Pit variant.
A corn leshy troop matches only the leshy side, with no deer or eating-leshy scenario.
This is a troop of corn leshies with defensive maze and plant-growth abilities, without deer attempting to eat them. Leshy identity alone does not supply that encounter.
A leaf leshy supplies only potential plant prey; its root and abilities do not identify deer trying to eat leshys.
This leaf leshy has plant identity and tree transformation, but no deer or grazing encounter. A possible prey creature alone is insufficient.
The animal has offensive fangs, claws and hunting maneuvers, but none of its complete attacks/abilities retaliates when it is punched. It meets only the animal component.
The smilodon is an animal, but its attacks and offensive abilities contain no damage triggered by punching it. Animal membership alone does not answer the defining behavior.
This grappling/pinching scizore is not a crowbar and supplies no prying alternative.
The scizore is a grappling and pinching crab-claw weapon, with no physical prying or crowbar function.
The trap suppresses a class feat through mental visions, without bodily transformation. A shared magical-trap category is insufficient.
This trap inflicts mental damage and can remove a class feat through a curse; it does not polymorph its victims. Sharing the trap category is insufficient.
Locate directly finds the direction to a previously observed lost object, explicitly including a specific sword. Range and lead/running-water limits are ordinary spell constraints.
Locate explicitly finds the direction of a specific observed object and even uses a sword as an example, directly answering the lost-sword function within its stated range and barriers.
The spell withers a creature through void damage and debilitation, related to bodily destruction but without disintegration, powdering or object destruction.

A useful qualified destructive-body spell alternative: it accelerates decomposition, deals void damage, and debilitates a creature. It does not disintegrate objects or reduce the target to powder, and has a shorter range.

adjudication.rationale: Accelerated Decomposition is related bodily-destruction magic: it withers a creature through void damage and debilitating conditions. It does not remove matter, reduce a target to powder or target objects. That leaves a thematic bodily-decline relation rather than a close demonstrated substitute for the named Disintegrate effect.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If Disintegrate is broad discovery of magic that destructively withers a body, the explicit decomposition plus damage/debilitation can be useful as a qualified alternative. It still lacks matter removal and object destruction.

opinions.rationale: Branwaen merely carries a Crowbar; the root creature is incidental equipment context.
Branwaen carries a crowbar; the returned character is incidental tool-owner context rather than the requested equipment.
A stinking-sap spray trap neither identifies deer nor causes them to eat leshys. Plant sap alone is not evidence of that scenario.
This trap coats creatures and equipment in stinking sap. It supplies no deer, leshy, or grazing interaction, so plant material alone does not satisfy the requested encounter.
An acid ooze with actual acid attacks directly answers broad acid discovery.
A direct acid-damage spell for the explicit spell filter.
The spell creates and bursts an acid shell for acid damage, directly answering acid spells.
A useful concealed pit variant with spikes and a gravel-covered hide lid, rather than the ordinary named Hidden Pit.
A useful concealed-pit variant: dirt-covered hide conceals a spike-filled pit. It is a different spiked design with its own attacks rather than the canonical Hidden Pit.
The effect only gives Kar combat/check bonuses. Resurrection occurs solely in its publication title, a coincidental match.
A related hot geothermal hazard, but its bubbling mud, sulfur poisoning and acid belch do not supply a lava flume or close lava-flow variant.
This geothermal mud hazard burns and vents sulfur, substantively related volcanic danger. It contains bubbling mud and gas rather than molten lava flowing through a flume.

Briargeist can innately cast Wall of Thorns and includes its full barrier mechanics. This is a useful caster example rather than the standalone spell.

adjudication.rationale: Useful qualified thorn-wall subject content: the briargeist actually has innate Wall of Thorns at eighth rank, and its root identifies it as an animate tangle of thorny vines and roots with additional intrinsic briarvine mechanics. This provides a thematically focused thorn creature and real barrier capability beyond an unrelated owner. The returned root is not the standalone spell, and its separate infestation ability grows a vine in a victim rather than a wall.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If the partial query seeks only the standalone Wall of Thorns spell, the creature remains an indirect caster/thematic reference, and its intrinsic infestation is not another wall-forming rule.

opinions.rationale: A human governor with scroll thaumaturgy is not a plausible emperor-cobra completion or related subject.
This human governor has no supplied identity, alias, or lore connecting him to emperor cob. General governmental status does not supply that entity.
The arboreal has a Thunderclap option nested within Storm of Vengeance, but is not dedicated thunderclap content or a close standalone alternative.
Dimari-Diji can cast Storm of Vengeance, whose thunderclap option deafens creatures in the storm. This is a qualified source of thunderclaps rather than a standalone Thunderclap entry.

adjudication.rationale: Useful indirect thunderclap provider: Dimari-Diji has associated innate Storm of Vengeance with an explicit Thunderclap option that deafens creatures in the storm. Its source also allows a free Sustain at turn start, supporting practical use of the sustained spell. This remains a creature and a selectable storm subeffect rather than dedicated thunderclap content. The entry label is Primal but its structured tradition is divine, so no resolution of that tradition discrepancy is assumed.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If the query is a dedicated thunderclap record lookup, this broad arboreal caster is only an embedded-spell example rather than that dedicated record.

The roc rider's intrinsic Avenging Bite reacts to an ally being attacked with a jaws Strike against that attacker, directly matching.

Arodeth has Disintegrate prepared and specifically incorporates it into Spellstrike, providing a concrete use of the spell with complete mechanics. The root is still a creature profile.

The rustler is a headless undead seeking its missing skull, with fast healing and a crafted explosive skull. It does not regrow severed heads; its head-related lore is only adjacent to the request.
The shadow double merely includes Augury, and its one-to-five-round lifetime is shorter than the spell’s ten-minute casting time. It is not a useful Augury answer.
The returned root is Marcien rather than the Augury spell. Its associated spontaneous repertoire includes Augury, but that is substantive casting context rather than the requested spell identity.
A dedicated Harrowkin family ability directly answers the broad Harrowkin subject.
The monster has melee branches and mantis/owlbear/unicorn forms, but none of its complete abilities fires tail spikes. No manticore form is supplied.
Root/system and all five embedded entries describe a plant construct with melee branches and mantis/owlbear/unicorn forms; none supplies shooting tail spikes.
A general consumables table lists a Lesser Healing Potion, not Minor; this is an incidental reference to a related tier, with no potion mechanics.
The table merely lists Healing Potion (Lesser), a different variant, among many consumables. It gives no Minor potion mechanics.
An explicitly identified owlbear regional variant directly answers the owlbear subject.
A mummy guardian has no supported connection to emperor cob or cobra; the publication title does not create a creature identity.
Cilios is a mummy guardian with no supplied connection or alias identifying emperor cob.
Exact Disintegrate spell with its object/force destruction and creature-powdering mechanics.
The exact Disintegrate spell supplies attack, save, damage, destruction and heightening mechanics.
A useful Spacious Pouch variant with larger capacity and higher level/price, rather than the requested Type I.
A related venting-vapor hazard, but it expels poison gas from blood rather than scalding steam. No heated-steam capability is supplied.
This is a related venting environmental hazard, but its blood pool emits poisonous gas rather than steam; it does not answer the named Steam Vents hazard.

Divine Armageddon is a deity-dependent area cataclysm, not a plausible completion of spiritual arma or an armament effect; the title fragment alone is coincidental.
A dedicated familiar route to Augury, useful indirectly because it grants the spell once per day to a familiar rather than providing the spell record; selection requires level8.
This dedicated Augury familiar ability explains once-daily casting, the required level, tradition and DC, directly useful for the unfiltered Augury request.
Stirvyn can destroy an unattended locked door with associated Disintegrate, a useful indirect/destructive opening option. Lock itself would not bypass an existing lock.
Stirvyn can cast Disintegrate to destroy an unattended door, providing a destructive way through a locked entrance. This does not unlock a door intact; his Lock spell instead secures one.
A useful nourishment-related character example combining personal plant nourishment with food-crafting expertise, rather than a general sustenance rule or item.
Popcorn has intrinsic Plant Nourishment, explicitly explaining how she obtains sustenance without ordinary purchased food and when she starves.
This stench aura causes sickened and a speed penalty, with no enfeeblement or useful Enfeebled rule content. Shared condition category is insufficient.
Putrid Stench sickens creatures and can slow their movement; it does not impose or explain enfeebled.

The root is Silene, with an associated innate Wall of Thorns spell; that is a reference through its repertoire rather than the requested spell record.

Wall of Thorns is a direct completion of the truncated spell name and creates the requested thorn wall.

Mocking Chorus explicitly regrows severed heads through hydra regeneration and specifies ten heads plus acid/fire cauterization limits.

Cleanse Cuisine explicitly removes all toxins and contaminations from food and beverages, directly cleansing a poisoned meal.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If the query seeks a dedicated thunderclap entry, this broad celestial supplies only an indirect spell-capability example.

adjudication.rationale: Useful qualified shield-combat example for the unfiltered broad subject: Worknesh actually holds a sturdy shield and has an associated spontaneous Shield spell whose complete text explains raising a magical shield and using its blocking reaction. She also lists Shield Block. This is practical shield-use context beyond a loose inventory noun, while the root remains a war leader rather than a shield item, standalone spell or base rule.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If shield means a dedicated shield item/spell/rule rather than practical user examples, Worknesh supplies only owner and combatant context. Her general leadership abilities are not a special shield mechanic.

Despite the title, Ogre Slug is explicitly a variant elite ogre glutton, a humanoid giant rather than a giant slug.
The field agent has a fully described Trap Finder capability that grants trap checks without Searching, a useful indirect creature example.
The field agent has an intrinsic Trap Finder ability explicitly allowing trap-finding checks even when not Searching. It directly meets the requested behavior.
Exact Spiritual Armament completion, with a ghostly weapon attack and sustain mechanics.
Spiritual Armament matches the supplied name fragment and provides full ghostly-weapon attack and sustain mechanics.

Anoreth incidentally wears a Ring of Sustenance as a bonded item. The profile includes its food and sleep benefits, but is not dedicated sustenance content.

This hazard directly consists of hidden steam vents emitting scalding steam, a direct source-supported answer to steam vents without requiring exclusive identity.

Direct climbing feat: grants a bonus, Combat Climber and fewer hands required to climb.

Gorums curse weakens damage dice and makes attacks nonlethal. It has no matching assurance-related name or mechanic.

The giant leech is a related large, salt-vulnerable soft-bodied damp-habitat predator, but the source identifies a toothed blood-feeding leech rather than a giant slug.

Ignitor is a practical clockwork means of igniting a flammable object within reach. It is useful for ignition as a function, though it is not the named attack cantrip.

A directly relevant ballista emplacement hazard, with firing and reload routine plus bolt attack.

This is a different subsystem and recipient scale from the named Battle Medicine request, with no source-supported identity/alias or individual-creature implementation.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If the short query is meant as broad battlefield-medicine subject discovery rather than looking up the named individual-scale option, this is a usable army-healing alternative. Its Kingmaker/army scope and Field Triage requirement must remain explicit.

The dragon can actually cast Create Water at will to produce water for drinking; Desert Thirst is an optional destructive alternative, so this is a qualified caster result.

The trap directly splatters victims with purple dye and explicitly affects clothing, matching the requested staining trap.

A related divine-armament spell alternative: Sacred Form gives the caster a sacred weapon within a battle form, rather than the separate Spiritual Armament spell.
The leather armor itself is animated into a guardian creature, giving a useful specialized subject variant. It is a combat creature rather than wearable Leather Armor equipment.

The root describes a gourd leshy and its plant abilities, but provides no deer or behavior of deer trying to eat leshies.

The root is exactly Steam Vents, with pressurized pipes and a steam-blast trigger.

The invader is directly a sea devil family member.

adjudication.rationale: Form Lock counteracts a polymorph already affecting a grabbed or restrained creature, substantively related to polymorph mechanics rather than supplying a Polymorph Trap. For a victim of a transformation trap it can undo that transformation, reversing the trap outcome on that victim.

opinions.rationale: Stirvyn has Disintegrate in his spontaneous repertoire, but this root NPC is only a caster reference for the named spell query.

Magic Passage can bypass a locked door through an adjacent suitable wall, rather than unlock the door itself. The tunnel is limited in depth and even a small metal layer blocks it.
This trap-setting ability incidentally permits observers to notice a snare if its activator fails Deception. It grants no passive trap-detection capability outside watching this specific activation.

This rule allows observing creatures to locate a snare without a Search action when they witness its activation and the member fails Deception. It is conditional on that activation, not general passive detection.

adjudication.rationale: Observers can learn the exact location of this hidden snare through their Perception DCs, with no Search action specified. This directly supplies a narrow way for noticing a trap without searching, conditional on seeing this particular activation and the member failing Deception; it is not a general passive trap-sensing capability.

opinions.rationale: The arctic roc is intrinsically frost-themed, immune to cold and capable of blasting ice-rimed feathers for cold damage. It directly answers broad frost discovery.

Marius has the Shield cantrip in his spontaneous casting entry, but the root creature is an ordinary caster reference rather than dedicated shield content.

Lotus Walk is related water-traversal magic, but it lets the caster walk on the surface and explicitly requires normal swimming underwater rather than granting a swim Speed.

The root prose says this manticore flings tail quills, but this exact scorpion-tail variant has only melee jaws, claw and a reach stinger with venom, with no ranged spike or volley. The assigned source conflicts about the defining capability, so usefulness as a tail-spike shooter is unresolved.

This is a useful qualified manticore-family result: generic prose explicitly describes flung tail quills, but this scorpion-tail variant’s complete combat entries instead provide only melee jaws, claws, and a venomous stinger. Its own spike-shooting capability remains ambiguous.

adjudication.rationale: Qualified useful manticore-family lead: the assigned root explicitly describes whipping its tail to fling deadly quills at prey. However, this scorpion-tail variant has only Jaws, Claw, a melee Stinger, and Manticore Venom; it supplies no ranged spike/volley attack. Thus its source is useful for identifying the described monster family while the exact variant cannot be asserted to shoot tail spikes mechanically.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If the intent requires establishing that this exact scorpion-tail stat block shoots projectiles, its generic quill-shooting prose and all-melee combat entries cannot be reconciled from the assigned source. Leave that exact capability unresolved rather than transfer a ranged attack from another manticore variant.

qualitativeUncertainty.rationale: If the intent requires establishing that this exact scorpion-tail stat block shoots projectiles, its generic quill-shooting prose and all-melee combat entries cannot be reconciled from the assigned source. Leave that exact capability unresolved rather than transfer a ranged attack from another manticore variant.

Possessing a kit does not by itself make the creature a useful climbing result.

alternativeGrades.rationale: The unfiltered one-word query can plausibly include climbing-support NPCs: intrinsic improved edge-grabbing and reduced falling consequences, together with an actual kit, provide qualified vertical-traversal utility. This reading treats adjacent climbing support as sufficient usefulness, while acknowledging no climb Speed or intrinsic Climb bonus.

adjudication.rationale: This fate/divination creature offers a useful qualified Augury alternative through its ordinary innate Read Omens, which gives future-facing advice, alongside dedicated divination lore. Augury itself is associated with Triumvirate Spells, but Triumvirate prose lists other granted spells; the source alone does not resolve unrestricted Augury availability, so this grade does not assert it.

alternativeGrades.rationale: For an intent confined to the Augury spell and its specific short-horizon good/bad assessment, Read Omens and general divination lore do not establish a useful substitute; exact Augury use remains internally qualified.

Blink dog lore explicitly says sages watch the heavens, interpret stellar signs and name dogs for their birth constellations, directly matching dogs that watch stars.
This skunk variant propels acrid musk that sickens targets, directly supplying the requested animal and spray capability. Its additional fiendish traits do not remove that fit.
This variant skunk retains the animal trait and explicitly sprays acrid musk that sickens targets. It directly supplies the requested animal capability.
The spell explicitly attempts to counteract poisons in food or water, directly providing a way to remove poison from a meal. Counteract success is its ordinary resolution condition.

Enhance Victuals explicitly attempts to counteract poisons in food before transformation, and successfully removed poison remains gone. This directly answers meal purification; the counteract check is an ordinary spell limitation.
A useful plausible Mirror Image completion: the dedicated spell effect explains and tracks illusory duplicates. It is spell-effect content rather than a physical mirror.

The dedicated Mirror Image effect supplies defensive illusory duplicates, useful mirror-image magic content for broad mirror discovery, qualified because it is neither a physical mirror nor the underlying spell.
This creature bounces its own body into a shove and then bites. Those mechanics do not substantively provide a rebounding thrown attack; bounding vocabulary alone is insufficient.

The creature bounces its own body while shoving and then bites; it neither tosses a weapon nor rebounds an attack to another target. The bouncing vocabulary does not establish a useful Rebounding Toss relation.
Teleportation Circle is a direct plausible completion of telepor and dedicated teleportation content, providing a ritual-created portal with specified cost, range, and destination rules.

Teleportation Circle is a plausible direct completion of telepor and explicitly creates an active teleporting portal. Ritual costs, casting time and destination limits do not make it an indirect subject answer.
Glorzia owns Leather Armor; the returned creature is incidental wearer context rather than the requested armor.
Padli carries a wand containing Magic Missile. That is possession context rather than the requested spell record, without assuming the owner can activate the wand.
Olansa contains Teleport as a self-only, tower-limited spell. This is related caster context for telepor rather than dedicated teleportation subject content.

Olansa has associated innate Teleport, offering a useful indirect teleportation reference for telepor. It is explicitly self-only within Terimor tower, so it does not supply general travel or transport companions.

adjudication.rationale: Olansa has innate Teleport with explicit self-only, within-tower limits; at-will availability does not change its authored ten-minute casting time. This is substantive specialized owner context for telepor, rather than general teleportation content or a transport-provider answer.

alternativeGrades.rationale: For broad discovery of teleporting creatures or specialized teleportation examples, her at-will tower movement is a useful qualified result; its recipient, location and casting-time limits remain material.

opinions.rationale: The saboteur carries a crowbar, providing possession context rather than the requested tool record.
The saboteur carries a crowbar. This is incidental ownership context rather than the requested tool record.
A useful hidden-pit variant: the camouflaged cover conceals a funnel-shaped spiked pit. It adds spikes and different pitfall mechanics rather than being the canonical Hidden Pit record.
This golem has an intrinsic steam vent attack, a useful related source of damaging steam-vent mechanics. It is a construct venting its internal forge rather than an environmental vent hazard.

The golem has a real internal-forge Vent action that releases damaging superheated steam, providing useful steam-vent capability content. It is a creature rather than a dedicated environmental steam-vent hazard.
Jadren contains Battle Medicine. This character is ownership context rather than the requested feat record.

Jadren has the Battle Medicine feat, but the character is an incidental build reference rather than the feat record. The cited feat retains its healer-tools requirement; possession of the feat alone is not proof of ready practical use.
This actual clockwork creature includes dedicated clockwork construction and disposer lore, directly answering the broad subject.
Tempest is a storm-themed mystery granting thunder spells, providing substantive thunder-related character-option context, but no authored Thunder Clap or dedicated thunderclap mechanics.
The tempest mystery has substantive storm flavor and explicitly grants thunder-themed spells, but the assigned source does not provide Thunderclap or establish a matching clap mechanic.
Izurran has Sure Strike and a luck reroll, but those do not establish Assurance or another authored completion of assur. Similar certainty-related wording is not sufficient.
Izurran is a catfolk witch with luck rerolls and curses; neither those mechanics nor his source identity establish an assur name completion or Assurance-style fixed skill result.
The purrodaemon contains Teleport, providing related spell ownership context for telepor rather than a dedicated teleport subject answer.
The purrodaemon has actual associated innate Teleport and at-will Dimension Door. It is useful indirect teleportation content for telepor, while remaining a creature root rather than a spell record.

adjudication.rationale: The purrodaemon genuinely has innate Teleport and both rank-5 and at-will rank-4 Dimension Door. The root lore is about bloodshed and weapons; for telepor as a partial spell lookup this is related caster context rather than dedicated teleportation subject content.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If telepor is broad discovery of usable teleporting creatures, the combination of group Teleport and at-will personal Dimension Door supplies a useful qualified creature answer.

opinions.rationale: Hyrune contains Sending among many spells, providing ownership context rather than the requested spell record.

Hyrune has Sending actually prepared, establishing a substantive spell reference. The vampire witch has no dedicated Sending relationship beyond spell-list inclusion, so is incidental named-spell context rather than the requested spell.
The feat expressly grants a swim Speed equal to land Speed, directly supplying the requested gain. Its aftermath prerequisite is explicit character-option eligibility.
The feat explicitly grants a swim Speed equal to land Speed, directly answering the function. Its rare aftermath prerequisite is stated rather than treated as an unstated exclusion.

Petitioner lore describes souls converted into quintessence to expand planes, a substantive planar-creation relationship. It supplies neither Create Demiplane nor an actionable demiplane-creation method.

Petitioner lore describes souls becoming quintessence that expands existing planes, a substantive planar-creation relationship, but this creature does not create a demiplane or supply the requested ritual.
This acid-spraying hazard is dedicated acid content and directly useful for the broad acid query.
This undead sheds skin and spreads disease; no resurrection capability is established. The word Resurrection occurs only in its publication title.

Lock strengthens a door against opening and invalidates existing keys, opposing the requested opening function for others. Its caster can reopen their own ward only if no additional lock bars it; it does not open an existing independent lock.

Lock is substantively related to door access but primarily seals the target, raises opening DCs and prevents old keys from working, reversing opening an already locked door. The caster opening its own lock is a stated exception, not general unlocking magic.
A flooding-room hazard is related to a dangerous flow, but this amphora pours water and causes drowning/pressure damage, not a lava flume.
This is a room-flooding water hazard, related through dangerous fluid inundation, but it produces water rather than lava and supplies no lava-flume mechanism. Flames are an image on the amphora.
The amoeba has intrinsic acid attacks, digestion, acid immunity, and a material limitation, directly useful acid-subject content.
The draconal contains Storm of Vengeance with a Thunderclap option, providing related spell ownership context. The returned celestial is not dedicated thunderclap content.

The red draconal has associated innate Storm of Vengeance with an explicit Thunderclap option that deafens creatures. This is useful indirect thunderclap capability content, not an exact Thunderclap spell identity.

adjudication.rationale: The draconal can produce an actual thunderclap through its associated innate Storm of Vengeance: creatures in the storm save against deafening. This is useful indirect thunderclap capability content, qualified by the enclosing storm spell and the inability to choose the same storm effect twice consecutively; it does not establish a different spell named Thunderclap.

opinions.rationale: Narseigus contains the Shield spell among many spells. This is incidental caster context rather than a dedicated shield answer.
Assurance is a direct plausible completion of assur, with its fixed-result skill-check mechanics.
Assurance is a direct plausible completion of assur, with its fixed skill-check result explicitly described.
This is a spectral horse monster with incorporeal movement and a horn, but no authored skinless anatomy. A ghostly horse is related equine-horror content, not the requested skinless creature.
The Pale Horse is a spectral incorporeal undead mount, a substantive supernatural-horse relation, but its source does not describe a skinless fleshy horse.
Aso berang is a forest guardian spirit/bear dog. No Assurance identity or other source-supported assur completion is established.
Aso Berang is a bear-dog forest spirit with anti-witch powers. Its name, lore and actions provide no supported assur completion or Assurance-style mechanic.
The high roller throws cards and can launch a card cone, so thrown attacks are substantively related. Its source does not provide a rebounding toss or a projectile bouncing between targets.
The source directly describes stargazing and astrology, but the creature is lizardfolk rather than a dog. It meets only the stargazing half of the request.
The stargazer explicitly studies stars for navigation and prediction, but is an iruxi lizardfolk rather than a dog. It meets the astronomical theme but not the requested creature concept.
The void pit transports creatures into outer space; it does not polymorph them. Sharing a magical-trap class is not a useful relationship to Polymorph Trap.
The Void Pit sends victims through a one-way portal into outer space and suffocates them. Shared magical-trap membership does not establish a polymorph or a transformation-trap alternative.
This is a mechanical spear-and-sliding-statue trap, not Emperor Cob. Its adventure publication is not identity evidence.
This mechanical room-tilting spear trap has no source-supported Emperor Cob identity or emperor-cobra subject. Its publication title does not establish relevance.
Juspix contains a polymorph spell and Alarm, providing related spell ownership context. The source does not combine them into a Polymorph Trap or identify a trap.
Juspix actually prepares Baleful Polymorph, so the transformation relationship is real, but the creature source supplies no Polymorph Trap or trapping mechanism.
Balisse is a confessor angel, not a ballista or a supported siege-weapon alternative. Similar title letters are coincidental.
Balisse is a confessor angel concerned with mortal moral dilemmas. Its similar-looking name does not make it a ballista or siege-weapon answer.
Disappearance hides a creature from senses rather than disintegrating matter. The similar title prefix does not make it a related functional alternative.
Disappearance hides a living creature from senses rather than destroying matter. Similar dis- naming and disappearance imagery do not supply Disintegrate or a useful destructive alternative.
The dragon intrinsically drains vigor through its bite, gaining temporary Hit Points while weakening living prey. That directly supplies vampiric function beyond its incidental vampiric spell record.

The ancient umbral dragon has actual life-draining jaws that grant temporary HP and associated innate Vampiric Exsanguination. This is useful vampiric-capability content through a dragon root rather than a dedicated vampire or spell record.

This spell explicitly grows an extradimensional demiplane and is a useful close alternative. It creates a fixed-size dwelling lasting until daily preparations rather than the named Create Demiplane ritual.
The hierophant contains Malignant Sustenance, which restores undead vigor, and an undead-healing aura. This is related healing context, not dedicated sustenance or food provision.

The hierophant has associated focus Malignant Sustenance, restoring undead vigor through fast healing. This is a qualified useful sustaining-undead reference for the broad query, with an undead-only recipient rather than ordinary nourishment.

adjudication.rationale: The hierophant supplies a concrete way to sustain undead vigor through associated focus Malignant Sustenance and an intrinsic fast-healing aura for allies with void healing. These make a qualified sustaining-undead answer, while the living-food/nourishment meaning of sustenance remains unmet.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If sustenance means food, water, or freedom from nutritional need, undead fast healing is related bodily maintenance rather than a useful nourishment answer.

opinions.rationale: The captain has telepathy and rope-swing movement, not teleportation. The shared tele prefix does not establish a useful telepor completion.
A royal basilisk is a direct specific basilisk creature answer. Its poison specialization and explicit lack of petrification distinguish it without excluding it from the broad basilisk subject.
The slime has intrinsic acid damage and a clear restriction to organic material, directly useful acid content.
This ooze is substantively acid-related, but its acid expressly damages metal, the reverse of the requested metal-sparing property.
The aquatic gray-ooze variant explicitly has acid that damages metal and organic material while sparing stone, reversing the requested metal preservation.
Minister Jo carries a sword cane and uses magical bolts, but supplies no sword-location method. Possessing a sword does not help find the requested lost sword.
Minister Jo carries a sword cane and uses combat bolts, but those possessions and actions do not locate a lost sword. An inventory sword is not object-finding capability.
The cultist contains Spiritual Weapon, a related ghostly weapon spell, but the returned root is incidental caster context for spiritual arma.
The cultist actually prepares Spiritual Weapon, a substantive ghostly-weapon relation, but the creature root is incidental spell-list context and has no verified Spiritual Armament alias.
A useful related thrown-weapon feat: it combines a ranged Feint, draw, and throw. It distracts one target rather than rebounding a projectile, so it is a distinct alternative.

Distracting Toss is related thrown-weapon combat, but feints with one weapon and attacks with another rather than rebounding a projectile. It does not supply the requested feat or a source-supported ricochet substitute.

adjudication.rationale: Distracting Toss feints with a weapon tossed into the air, then draws and attacks with another thrown weapon. The thrown-combat connection is substantive, but it supplies no rebounding or ricocheting projectile mechanism; sharing a weapon style does not establish a useful substitute for Rebounding Toss.

opinions.rationale: Zatqualmish contains Magic Missile among many spells. This is spell ownership context rather than the requested spell as subject.
This trap slashes creatures with silver blades; it provides no clothing-staining function. Bloodstains would be an invented consequence rather than an authored capability.
Silvered Retribution is a blade-damage trap with no authored clothes-staining effect. Possible blood stains from injuries would be an invented capability.
The scholar carries a Climbing Kit, providing related possession context rather than dedicated climbing content.

The scholar carries a climbing kit and is an explorer, giving substantive climbing context, but its special actions and movement do not provide a dedicated climbing capability or method beyond incidental equipment.
This flask explicitly deals acid, persistent acid and acid splash damage, directly useful for broad acid discovery.
This heritage directly improves climbing through gripping toes, hands-free climbing and improved Athletics results, answering the broad climbing subject.
This climbing-focused heritage grants Combat Climber, enables barefoot hands-free climbing and improves successful climb checks, directly answering climbing discovery.
A useful creature-based lava alternative: its intrinsic breath blasts magma and can leave clinging burning magma on victims. It is a dragon attack rather than a dedicated environmental lava flume.

This exact ancient spellcaster dragon actually projects magma and prepares Volcanic Eruption with a lava column. It is useful indirect lava-projection content, with a creature root and no Lava Flume identity.
This is a sun-and-moon canine manifestation, not a bulette. Its similar name prefix does not establish a substantive relationship.
Bul-Gae is a supernatural canine representing eclipsed sun and moon, not a bulette or a bulette variant. Similar initial letters do not establish relevance.
The feat improves survival against a spellcaster after a critical save; it does not restore life. Resurrection in the publication title is incidental.
The trap floods a room with river water and causes impact/drowning danger. It supplies no staining substance or authored clothing stain.
The trap floods the room with river water and can knock creatures down, but has no authored dye, marking or clothes-staining effect. Mere soaking is not evidence of staining.

This alien avoids conflict and solicits help through charm, making it related benign-alien content. It is a furry spherical moon mole rather than a jellyfish, and imposed helpfulness is not proof of its own friendly disposition.

Zuipnyrn is genuinely alien and avoids conflict, but is a furry spherical moon-mole with an eye stalk rather than a jellyfish. Its charm makes others helpful toward it, which does not establish its own friendliness.
Ygrik wears Leather Armor; this creature record is incidental wearer context rather than the armor subject.
The ravener discorporates its own body into soul energy and later returns, related bodily dissolution. It is an escape ability rather than Disintegrate or a means to destroy a target.

Discorporate temporarily converts the ravener own body into soul energy for escape, a substantive dematerialization relation, but does not destroy a target or provide Disintegrate. The body returns later.
This enormous war construct has no source-supported Assurance completion or meaningful assur relationship.
The Numerian Guthallah is an ancient robotic war construct with a natural-19 combat rule. Its identity and mechanics do not supply an assur completion or Assurance fixed skill result.
The standard is a heraldic banner mountable on a polearm; it has no object-finding capability. A weapon mounting does not locate a lost sword.
The standard is a heraldic banner that can attach to a polearm or spear. It does not locate lost objects or swords.

The necromancer contains vampiric spells and a spell-heightening interaction, providing substantive spell context, but its own identity and intrinsic powers are poison-focused rather than a dedicated vampiric subject.

The necromancer has actual spontaneous Vampiric Maiden and signature Vampiric Touch, both draining victims to grant temporary HP. This is useful indirect vampiric-caster content within a poison-themed undead root.

adjudication.rationale: This caster provides useful vampiric-magic content: its spontaneous repertoire includes Vampiric Maiden and signature Vampiric Touch, both draining targets to gain temporary HP. The root is a poison-themed virulak rather than a vampire, so it is a qualified caster example for the broad vampiric query; no vampire identity is inferred.

opinions.rationale: The supplied verified Sea Devil Baron alias identifies this as sea-devil family content, and the root describes the amphibious predatory humanoid. A speaker is a direct instance of the broad sea devil subject.
The verified Sea Devil Baron alias establishes this sedacthy as a direct sea-devil creature result, supported by its aquatic family lore.
Ashrin is an alchemist with fiendish and object-intuition abilities, but no authored Assurance completion or meaningful assur subject.
Ashrin is a demon-influenced munavri alchemist. Intuit Object grants temporary item-specific training but does not supply an assur name completion or Assurance-style fixed result.
This spell disperses the caster into air temporarily after damage, a substantive bodily-dissolution relation. It does not provide Disintegrate or destroy another target.
The spell temporarily disperses the caster into air as a defensive escape, a substantive dematerialization relation, but it re-forms the caster and does not disintegrate a target.
The dragon contains the Shield spell among many spells, providing incidental caster context rather than dedicated shield content.
Feet to Fins directly grants a willing target a swim Speed, with an explicit land-movement tradeoff and duration.
Feet to Fins directly grants a willing creature a swim Speed equal to normal land Speed. Its reduced land Speed and temporary duration are explicit ordinary tradeoffs.
The feat directly offers a 10-foot swim Speed as one of its choices, satisfying the requested gain.
Sublime Mobility explicitly allows choosing a 10-foot swim Speed, directly fulfilling gain a swim speed with a nephilim feat.
Avathrael contains Wall of Thorns among many spells, providing related ownership context rather than the requested wall spell as subject.

Avathrael has associated innate Wall of Thorns, a real reference, but the dragon root is incidental spell-list context. Its separate shadow-terrain power does not make it a thorn-wall record or establish a different thorn-wall method.
This is a shortsword-like shard of the Orb of Gold Dragonkind. Its dragon-specific artifact relationship does not establish Armageddon Orb or an apocalyptic function.

This is a shard of the Orb of Gold Dragonkind functioning as a dragon-slaying shortsword and empowering that specific dragon orb. It has no Armageddon Orb relationship; the word orb alone is insufficient.
The spell deals magical force damage, substantively related to force offense, but it requires counteracting a magic item or spell to trigger an explosion rather than supplying Magic Missile.

Detonate Magic shares force damage with Magic Missile, but must counteract an existing magic item or effect to create an explosion. It does not supply force darts or a close independent missile attack.

A useful qualified entry-tool alternative: the knocker assists unlocking and creates a door through some barriers. It uses Thievery and magic rather than a crowbar's physical prying, and fails through metal or overly thick surfaces.

The knocker is a useful qualified entry-tool alternative to a crowbar: it aids lock picking and can create a temporary door through nonmetal material. It does not provide the mundane prying tool or its Force Open function.
The wand casts Floating Flame and generates damaging rolling flames, directly answering a broad fire-wand request.
This dedicated harrowkin family rule explains suit affiliation and shared abilities, directly useful for harrowkin.
The swarm intrinsically deals acid damage and specifies what materials the acid affects, directly useful broad acid content.
The amoeba swarm has intrinsic acid damage and an explicit organic-only Weak Acid rule. This directly answers broad acid content discovery through an acid-defined ooze.
The feat explicitly returns its owner to life after death if unused and remains survive, directly answering resurrection. Its self-only use and daily frequency are ordinary stated limits.
This beacon hazard releases cold and void energy and pushes creatures, without staining clothing. Shadow terminology is not a stain mechanism.
Shadow Discharge deals cold and void energy damage and pushes creatures away. It does not stain or mark clothes; shadow imagery is not a dye mechanic.
The robe is dedicated acid equipment: it grants acid resistance and uses acid-assisted handholds for climbing. Broad acid intent includes protection as well as damage.
A bola is a cord-and-weight throwing weapon for bludgeoning or entangling legs, with no ballista mechanism or meaningful ballista relationship.
A bola is a corded thrown entangling weapon, not a ballista or a meaningful siege-weapon variant. Shared ranged-weapon membership is insufficient.
Elga carries an Owlbear Claw talisman, providing incidental item context. The claw is explicitly not always from an owlbear, and the root does not supply the owlbear creature.
The feat directly grants a 15-foot swim Speed, with wave-order eligibility and an additional benefit for existing swimmers.
Natural Swimmer explicitly grants a 15-foot swim Speed through a wave-order druid feat, directly fulfilling the requested gain.
The hired hand wears Leather Armor; the returned individual is incidental wearer context rather than the armor itself.
The enforcer wears studded leather, a related armor variant, but this owner record is incidental possession context rather than a useful armor record.
The Cricket is explicitly a fabled harrowkin and has dedicated harrowkin lore, directly answering the family subject despite its card-name title.
This is a fire genie whose authored transformations are fire elementals or reptiles, not a griffon or useful griffon alternative.
The Ifrit is a fire genie with no griffon identity or griffon subject matter. Its verified Efreeti alias does not connect it to Griffon.
The runes explode and silence victims in a chute, without breaking lockpicks. The thief-related title does not establish the requested equipment-damaging mechanism.
Despite its title, this trap is a rune-triggered fire explosion and silence effect in a chute, with no lockpick-breaking mechanic or lock interaction.
This trap launches excrement and rotten food onto the opener, with persistent filth requiring full washing. It directly supplies the requested clothes-soiling trap concept.

Stinkface Surprise actually soils its victim with excrement and rotten food requiring a thorough wash, a useful qualified mess-making trap alternative. It does not explicitly describe coloring or lasting fabric stains.
The ooze is directly acid-related but its acid explicitly damages metal and its surface harms metal weapons, opposing the requested metal-preservation property.
The verdurous ooze explicitly corrodes metal and flesh, and metal weapons can take acid damage from its surface. This directly opposes the requested preservation of metal.
The Peacock is explicitly a fabled harrowkin with dedicated family lore, directly useful harrowkin content.
The Peacock is explicitly a variant fabled harrowkin, with direct harrowkin family lore. Its card-based title does not make its family relationship incidental.
The cart has an intrinsic engine steam discharge, a useful related steam-vent example. It produces a short concealment cloud after collision rather than an environmental damaging vent hazard.

The steam cart actually expels steam from its engine when damaged in a collision, a useful qualified steam-venting alternative. It provides a short concealment cloud rather than a damaging environmental Steam Vents hazard.
This is an actual sea devil brute with dedicated family lore, directly answering the broad sea devil subject.
The brute is explicitly a Sea Devil with dedicated family lore and trait, directly answering the broad family query.

The reaction bites after the mutant itself is critically hit, a substantive retaliatory-bite relationship. It neither triggers on an ally being attacked nor identifies a creature possessing that requested capability.

This is a related retaliatory bite ability, but its trigger is a critical hit against the mutant itself, not an attack on an ally. It is also a family rule rather than an identified creature satisfying the request.
Nahoa has Combat Climber and a climbing biography episode, providing character context rather than a dedicated climbing method or item.

Level-3 Nahoa has actually granted Combat Climber and Athletics expertise, providing useful climbing-build content. The feat allows one occupied hand but still requires another hand and both legs; it is not a climb Speed.

adjudication.rationale: Nahoa offers useful climbing-build content: Combat Climber is actually granted by Pitborn, and he is expert in Athletics. The feat removes off-guard while climbing and permits an occupied hand, while still requiring the other hand and both legs; this is a qualified character example, not an innate climb Speed.

opinions.rationale: This is a normal domesticated war horse, with no skinless anatomy or monstrous equine-horror characterization. Horse identity alone is insufficient for the combined request.
This is an ordinary domestic war horse, with no skinless or monstrous exposed-flesh source evidence. The horse noun alone does not satisfy the requested concept.
The wight has an actual intrinsic body-rigged snare that fires bone slivers on death. This directly supplies a specific snare instance for the broad unfiltered query.
The hunter wight has a real snare rigged into its own body, triggered on destruction, beyond its carried snare kit. This directly supplies snare content for the broad query.
The meokdan is perpetually hungry regardless of eating, a substantive unsatisfied-hunger theme. It is an eater, not a banquet or a source of never-satisfying food for others.

The meokdan has explicitly insatiable hunger, giving a substantive never-satisfied-eating theme, but is a hungry creature rather than an unsatisfying banquet or food-producing encounter. Its Snack ability heals it rather than making a banquet for others.
Kzininn's origin recounts a consequence of Desna releasing Ghlaunder. This is an incidental mythic relationship, not a dedicated Desna lore record.
This masked psychopomp guards souls and investigates interference with death, without a ballista relationship.
Morrigna are psychopomp bounty hunters and soul investigators with web wrappings and a staff. The source establishes no ballista identity or siege-weapon relationship.
Storied Harrowkin is an explicit harrowkin creature with dedicated family lore, directly satisfying the subject.
This animated clock tower is an actual clockwork construct creature, directly matching the filtered category.
This is an animated severed head, a substantive decapitation-monster relationship. Its bite and void-healing mechanics do not provide regrowth of a missing head.

The creature is itself a reanimated severed head, a substantive decapitation relationship, but the complete root and its abilities establish biting and void healing rather than regrowth of heads on a monster.
The scout is explicitly a sea devil with dedicated family lore, a direct broad-subject instance.
The scout is explicitly a Sea Devil with dedicated family lore and trait, directly answering sea-devil discovery.
The floor emits cold air and frost jets with persistent cold/frostbite effects, directly useful frost content.
The heart has a specific Disintegrate interaction, replacing instant destruction with double damage ignoring Hardness. It is a target-specific related reference rather than the spell itself.

The cluster heart has dedicated Disintegrate interaction rules, but explicitly prevents that spell from destroying it outright and substitutes damage. This opposes the spell normal object-destruction outcome for this target.

adjudication.rationale: The heart has a specific rule for Disintegrate and so is substantively related to the spell. For this target the rule expressly negates outright destruction and substitutes double damage ignoring Hardness. The opposite flag is confined to the instant object-destruction outcome, not a claim that all spell damage is prevented.

opinions.rationale: This shield rune disarms a blocked melee attacker; it does not toss, rebound, or redirect a thrown weapon. Catching terminology alone is insufficient.
The Catching shield rune disarms a melee attacker after Shield Block. It neither throws nor rebounds a projectile, and the catching label alone does not connect it to Rebounding Toss.
Reaching Rings is a fungus leshy adventurer, but the source supplies no deer or deer-eating encounter. A potential leshy victim alone does not establish the requested event.
Reaching Rings is a leshy character, related to the requested prey, but the source provides no deer or deer-feeding encounter. Sharing the adventure context does not establish the requested threat.
Skartitch carries Disintegration Bolts that invoke Disintegrate, providing related gear ownership context rather than the requested spell subject.

Skartitch has held disintegration bolts with explicit Interact activation and a matching crossbow attack. This is useful indirect Disintegrate-delivery content through ammunition, qualified by needing a hit and a DC 34 save, rather than the spell record.

adjudication.rationale: Skartitch supplies a concrete indirect delivery alternative for Disintegrate: she has three activatable disintegration bolts and a linked crossbow attack capable of firing them. The bolts explicitly apply the spell on a hit with DC 34 Fortitude, so this is useful ammunition-based encounter content rather than an assertion that she casts Disintegrate. It remains a creature root and requires activation and a successful hit.

alternativeGrades.rationale: If Disintegrate seeks only the named spell record and its casting rules, the creature remains an equipment-user example rather than that spell or its rules.

opinions.rationale: Mother Venom contains Magic Missile among many spells. The root creature is incidental ownership context rather than the spell record.

Mother Venom has Magic Missile associated with a spontaneous spellcasting entry, but the creature root is incidental spell-list context rather than the named spell. The source entry naming/tradition fields disagree, without affecting that reference relationship.
This dedicated Frost Breath effect supplies cold resistance, directly useful frost-related effect content for the broad query.
The hazard explicitly consists of deer investigating and nibbling leshys, directly matching the requested situation despite being represented as a hazard.
The grazing-deer hazard explicitly tries to nibble delicious-looking leshys, directly supplying the requested encounter regardless of the lack of a kind filter.
Lini contains Ignition among her spells, providing related ownership context rather than the spell record itself.
This exact level-5 Lini actually prepares Ignition, but the animal-druid character is incidental spell-list context rather than the requested spell or dedicated ignition content.
This ooze attacks and heals through blood, slashing and bleeding, with no acid or metal-preservation mechanism. Being an ooze alone is insufficient.

The blood ooze uses blood consumption, bleeding, clotting and vitality siphoning; the complete root and all embedded abilities provide no acid. Shared ooze membership alone does not support the requested metal-sparing acid creature.
This alien three-armed, three-legged emotion feeder has no authored bulette identity or meaningful relationship.
Quelaunt is a three-limbed emotion-feeding aberration, not a bulette or a source-supported bulette alternative.
This is an undead bear with damaging jaws and corpse eating, related animated-bear horror content. Its source does not make it a stuffed toy or taxidermy bear.
The ghastly bear is a supernatural biting bear, a substantive related monster, but its ghoul traits, corpse consumption and disease do not establish a stuffed toy or taxidermic bear.
The spell freezes moisture into damaging ice shards and a cold flurry, directly useful frost spell content.
Frigid Flurry freezes ambient moisture into jagged ice and deals cold damage, directly supplying a frost-themed spell.
This feat is dedicated shield preservation content, directly useful for the broad unfiltered shield subject. It protects a blocked-with shield from destruction.
Shield Salvation is a dedicated shield feat that prevents a Shield Block from destroying the shield outright, directly answering broad shield content discovery.
Izhkarial carries a Type IV spacious pouch. This is ownership context for a related pouch variant rather than the requested Type I item.
Izhkarial incidentally carries a Type IV spacious pouch. This creature is neither the requested Type I item nor a dedicated explanation of that variant.
